**@cv** commented (https://github.com/cv/pi-action/issues/33#issuecomment-6814200029):

decisions: 
- The proposed defaults: 10 MB per file, 100 MB per snapshot (configurable)
- Denylist for `.env*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `id_rsa*`, etc files also configurable (files in `git check-ignore` are always ignored. Default empty)
- The snapshot pointer visible to the action only, not to the model (no `pi.worktree` for now).
- Cleanup of `refs/pi/worktrees/*` left as a follow-up.

Do this as one PR, small commits along the way.

_(pi-action posts your final response as a comment here. Don't also post it with `gh`.)_
